  • Classes in com.google.adk.workflow used by com.google.adk.workflow
    Class
    Description
    BaseNode
    Base class for nodes in a workflow graph.
    ConfirmationPredicate
    A predicate that decides for each input whether a FunctionNode run asks the user to approve it, set with FunctionNode.Builder.requireConfirmation(ConfirmationPredicate).
    Edge
    A connection between two nodes in a workflow graph.
    EdgesBuilder
    A builder for the edges of a workflow graph, declared as chains of calls that start at EdgesBuilder.from(Node) or EdgesBuilder.fromStart().
    EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain
    A chain of edges positioned at a node, started by EdgesBuilder.from(Node), EdgesBuilder.fromStart() or EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(JoinNode).
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    A chain of edges positioned at a node group from a fan-out, EdgesBuilder.from(Node, Node, Node...), or EdgesBuilder.from(Collection), which EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(JoinNode) connects to a JoinNode.
    EdgesBuilder.RouteMap
    A routing map configured in EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain.route(Consumer) that maps each route the source node may emit to the nodes it leads to, written r.on("billing").then(billing).
    EdgesBuilder.RouteMapEntry
    A routing-map entry started by EdgesBuilder.RouteMap.on(String) whose routes have no target yet; EdgesBuilder.RouteMapEntry.then(Node, Node...) completes it.
    EdgesBuilder.RouteSet
    A set of routes that select a single edge, which fires once when its source emits any of them; separate edges to the same target would fire once each.
    FunctionNode
    A workflow node that runs a Java function on each input, with a type per port; build one with FunctionNodes.of(String, Class, Class, NodeBody) or FunctionNodes.builder(Class, Class).
    FunctionNode.Builder
    Fluent builder for FunctionNode.
    JoinNode
    A node that waits for every predecessor to complete, then outputs their outputs keyed by predecessor name.
    JoinNode.Builder
    Builder for JoinNode.
    Node
    A unit of work in a workflow graph.
    NodeBody
    The body of a FunctionNode, which takes the node run's context and its single input; the input may be shared with other nodes, so the body must not mutate it.
    NodeConfig
    A node's retry policy and execution timeout.
    NodeConfig.Builder
    Builder for NodeConfig.
    NodeExecutionException
    Base class for node failures raised by the workflow runtime, such as NodeTimeoutException.
    NodeInfo
    The identity of the workflow-node activation that emitted an Event.
    NodeInfo.Builder
    Builder for NodeInfo.
    RequestInput
    A node's request for user input, which pauses the workflow until the user answers it.
    RequestInput.Builder
    Builder for RequestInput.
    RetryConfig
    How a node is retried when it fails.
    RetryConfig.Builder
    Builder for RetryConfig.
    Route
    A value on a workflow edge, and the value a node emits to select which of its outgoing edges are followed.
    Route.Default
    The fallback edge, followed when no other routed edge of the node matches what it emitted, including when it emitted no route.
    RunNodeConfig
    Configuration for running a child node with Context.runNode(Node).
    RunNodeConfig.Builder
    Builder for RunNodeConfig.
    Start
    The node that marks where a workflow graph starts.
    Workflow
    A graph of nodes that is itself a node, so a workflow can go wherever a node can, including in another workflow.
    Workflow.Builder
    Builder for Workflow.
    WorkflowDataException
    Thrown when data arriving during a run does not fit the receiving node, such as an answer it cannot route on.
